title: Sprint-strata roadmap: component gating and OKR mapping for Private/VPC trimestrial rollout
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Produce an operationalized quarterly rollout plan for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise customers that ties component-level gating to OKRs and readiness signals. This ticket defines the sprint-strata (layered sprint) approach: break the rollout into independent components (networking, provisioning, telemetry, upgrade/rollback) and map each to OKR success criteria, acceptance criteria, and automated signals. Deliverables: 1) tranche gating matrix; 2) per-component runbooks for canary & rollback; 3) OKR mapping doc and dashboard queries; 4) final activation calendar and cross-team owners.
acceptance_criteria: Gating matrix completed with explicit pass/fail signals for each component
Runbooks created for canary, rollback, and emergency upgrade; reviewed by SRE and Security
OKR mapping document with measurable metrics and thresholds published to Confluence
Dashboard queries (cost, latency, error rate, upgrade failure rate) defined and verified in Grafana
Cross-team dependencies enumerated and owners acknowledged in the calendar
success_metrics: Onboarding time per tenant <= 3 business days
Upgrade failure rate < 1% during tranche windows
Latency SLOs met for 95th percentile within allocated capacity tiers
Customer support escalations related to activation reduced by 50% vs prior quarter
milestones: 2025-01-20: Draft gating matrix and component list
2025-02-03: Runbooks and canary plan reviewed by SRE
2025-02-17: OKR mapping published and dashboard panels provisioned
2025-03-10: First tranche activation dry-run with internal tenants
risks: Intermittent KV cache invalidation under burst traffic could block canary acceptance
Network policy mismatches across customer VPCs may cause provisioning delays
Insufficient telemetry retention for post-activation regression analysis
Security review timelines (KMS/HSM integration) may slip and delay release
decisions: Adopt cohort-based gating: light -> medium -> heavy tenant groups to reduce blast radius
Use feature-flag + capacity-fence pattern to expose Private features per-tenancy
Require security sign-off (KMS integration) before any public activation tranche
Delay wide rollout if upgrade failure rate exceeds 0.5% during internal dry-run
